title: SDOA v5.5 Sleeve Telemetry Standard — Amendment 3.1
description: Canonical event shapes for all sleeve lifecycle telemetry. Every event emitted by a sleeve sovereign must conform to the base fields plus the event-specific fields defined here. Consumers (Triage, Cartographer, Chronicle, tracksdoa.us) must accept these shapes.

baseFields.description: Required on every sleeve telemetry event.

moduleId.description: MANIFEST id of the emitting sleeve

sleeve:init.description: Emitted at the end of init(). Signals that the sleeve has completed path resolution and health check. Healthy or not, init always emits this event.

healthy.description: true if _healthCheck() passed, false if it threw

resolvedPath.description: The path resolved by PathResolver, or null if path is auto

sleeve:run.description: Emitted at the entry of run(), before _callExternal() is invoked. Allows tracing calls that never complete (timeouts, process crashes). Paired with sleeve:boundaryCall by correlationId.

correlationId.description: UUID linking sleeve:run to its sleeve:boundaryCall outcome

sleeve:boundaryCall.description: Emitted after run() completes (success or failure). The primary telemetry event for boundary latency, error rate, and drift analysis.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the full run() call

correlationId.description: UUID matching the sleeve:run event that started this call

sleeve:boundaryFault.description: Emitted when run() completes with ok=false. Distinct from sleeve:boundaryCall so fault consumers (Triage circuit breaker, Cartographer drift) can subscribe selectively without filtering.

error.description: Error message from the failed call or normalization

correlationId.description: UUID matching the sleeve:run that opened this call

sleeve:health.description: Emitted by periodic health checks (not only on failure). Allows dashboards and Oracle to track health status over time without requiring a live call.

healthy.description: true = external system responded to health probe

latencyMs.description: Round-trip latency of the health probe, null if skipped

detail.description: Optional detail string, e.g. model version or endpoint status

sleeve:disposed.description: Emitted at the end of dispose(). Signals that the sleeve has torn down external connections and is no longer active.

reason.description: Optional reason for disposal (e.g. registry shutdown, hot-swap)

sleeve:batchDispatched.description: Amendment 4.5 — emitted after batchExternalCalls() completes a chunk group. Replaces N individual sleeve:boundaryCall events with a single aggregate event when calls are batched. Carries total callCount, overall durationMs (wall clock for all chunks), and ok (false if any result failed). batchId links to the originating batchExternalCalls() invocation.

callCount.description: Total number of individual calls in the batch

durationMs.description: Wall-clock duration of the full batch dispatch

ok.description: false if any result in the batch failed

sleeve:payloadCompressed.description: Amendment 4.5 — emitted when compressPayload() is called explicitly. Provides before/after byte counts and compression ratio for boundary traffic analysis. Not emitted for automatic compression inside run() — see sleeve:boundaryCall for that context.

command.description: Command context if compression was triggered within a run() call, else null

originalBytes.description: Byte size of the JSON-serialised payload before compression

sleeve:loraTrainingStarted.description: Amendment 4.4 — emitted when trainLoRA() begins fine-tuning a LoRA adapter on a model sleeve. Long-running; may not complete for minutes. Paired with sleeve:loraTrainingComplete by adapterId.

adapterId.description: UUID identifying this training run and the resulting adapter

sleeve:loraTrainingComplete.description: Amendment 4.4 — emitted when trainLoRA() finishes. Carries training loss and duration. A low loss alone does not indicate the adapter is ready — validateLoRA() must pass before proposeModelUpgrade() is allowed.

loss.description: Final training loss, null if the external system did not report it

ok.description: false if training failed (loss diverged, OOM, etc.)

sleeve:loraValidated.description: Amendment 4.4 — emitted after validateLoRA() runs test cases against a trained adapter. The adapter may only be proposed for governance approval when passed=true.

passed.description: true if all required test cases passed at or above quality threshold

score.description: Normalized quality score 0–1 from the test suite

sleeve:modelUpgradeProposed.description: Amendment 4.4 — emitted by proposeModelUpgrade() after a validated adapter passes the pre-proposal gate. Routes to Coach for governance approval. The sleeve cannot self-approve — this is a proposal only.

proposalId.description: UUID for this proposal; paired with coach:modelUpgradeApproved or coach:modelUpgradeRejected

validationScore.description: Score from the most recent validateLoRA() run

proposedReason.description: Human-readable reason for proposing this upgrade

sleeve:transportNegotiated.description: Amendment 4.1 — emitted when negotiateTransport() selects a different transport than the one currently active. Carries the previous transport, the new selection, scoring reasons, and a per-transport score array so Cartographer can track transport stability over time. Not emitted if negotiation produces no change.

previousTransport.description: Transport that was active before renegotiation

reason.description: Comma-joined scoring factors for the winning transport

scores.description: Array of { transport, score, viable, reason } for all candidates

sleeve:sandboxRun.description: Amendment 3.5 — emitted instead of sleeve:boundaryCall when the sleeve is in sandbox mode. Signals that the response came from a fixture or Chronicle replay, NOT from the real external system. Downstream consumers (Triage circuit breakers, Cartographer drift, Pulse scoring) must never act on this event — it is for Chronicle audit and test harness use only.

durationMs.description: Wall-clock time of fixture lookup (will be near-zero)

ok.description: Whether the fixture returned a success response

replay.description: true if the fixture came from Chronicle replay, false if injected manually

fixtureKey.description: The command key used to look up the fixture ('*' means wildcard)

sleeve:modelInfo.description: Amendment 3.3 — emitted by model sleeves (AI inference boundaries) at init() and optionally after each health check. Provides model version, hash, and declared capabilities so Cartographer can detect version drift across deployments. Non-model sleeves never emit this event.

modelVersion.description: Model identifier, e.g. 'Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Q4_K_M' or API model name

modelHash.description: SHA-256 or provider-reported hash of the model weights, null if unavailable

declaredCapabilities.description: Capabilities the model reports it supports (from introspection or provider metadata)

sleeve:commandDiscovered.description: Amendment 3.2 — emitted when runDiscovery() finds external commands not declared in MANIFEST external.commands. This is a PROPOSAL only — the sleeve cannot self-approve. Coach receives this event and routes a manifest amendment through ProbationOfficer → Registrar.fieldChampion(). If ProbationOfficer rejects the amended source, the proposal is silently dropped.

discoveredCommands.description: All commands found on the external system

undeclaredCommands.description: Subset of discoveredCommands not in currentCommands — the proposed additions

proposalId.description: UUID identifying this proposal; paired with coach:mutationReady or coach:patchRejected
